Description: Production PC example: an 'operator' account, a static IP address on the wired card, the PLC in the hosts file, an NTP time server, an Exports share, a clean-up task running as the operator, a power plan that never sleeps and Windows Search turned off. Asks for the operator password and the addresses. Changes this PC.

Items.Comment: The operator password is asked for once: the account and the scheduled task use the same placeholder.

AccountPolicy.Comment: No lockout, so a mistyped password never stops production.

SmbShares.Name: Exports
SmbShares.Description: Production exports, read-only on the network

NetworkCards.Comment: The one wired card; fails on a PC with several, use Description or Name then.

IPSettings.PrefixLength: {{prefix:Prefix length of the production network, such as 24}}

TimeServerNames: {{ipv4:IP address of the NTP time server}}

ScheduledTasks.Comment: Runs whether or not the operator is signed in; the restore gives the operator 'Log on as a batch job'.

Services.Comment: Windows Search indexing is not needed on a production PC.
Services.Name: WSearch
